Name: Combine or Divide Milk and Eggs
Author: physiowitcher
Description:
想要将大瓶牛奶/羊奶变为小瓶？拜托，你们星露谷人难道连这个都要人教吗？自己去厨房把大瓶的奶倒在小瓶里不就好了，反之亦然。两大瓶牛奶的量约等于三小瓶，而三大瓶羊奶约等于五小瓶羊奶。你说鸡蛋？怎么可能有人能把一个鸡蛋变成两个或者反过来？除非你有个会魔法的朋友——比如说在mod设置中将这个功能打开什么的……

Want to turn a large bottle of milk/goat's milk into a small bottle? Just pour milk from a large bottle into a small bottle, and vice versa. You can do this simple job in the kitchen. A large bottle of milk is equal to about one and a half small bottles of milk, and a large bottle of goat's milk is equal to about one and two thirds of small bottles of goat's milk.
As for the eggs? Come on dude, you know it's impossible, no one can turn one egg into two or vice versa - unless you bad guy uses some "magical spell" - such as turning those two options on in the mod Settings……

自己随手写的自用模组。模组功能比较简单——万一这都有bug的话也欢迎评论告知，不过我的回复可能不及时。欢迎随意魔改
Just a self-use mod. Feel free to rewrite as you like!
